'''Wraid ampulla jelly''' was an ingredient used in cooking and sourced from [[Wraid]]s. The jelly was harvested on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] from the Wraid [[Trapjaw]] for use during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Wraid" />
